faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Rohtas Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Rohtas Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk, 1 Peon / Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Rohtas Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Rohtas at Sasaram, by personally or through registered post, to reach by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Remuneration governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority; no amount printed.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years as per Patna High Court guidelines; Stenographer needs experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing; Clerk needs knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Must have retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the post. Must possess satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection based on service records and applicable rules.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual engagement, can be terminated at any time as per directions of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. No right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Evening Court, Rohtas.
